fit2_with_substrate_term.form: C/(eps_eff a) = A + B ln(a/g) - F (a/h),  h = 500 um

note: Plain a/g scaling has a ~14 pct systematic residual that grows with a at fixed g -- the finite 500um substrate breaks the scale invariance. The a/h term absorbs it (max resid 14 pct -> 7 pct); A2,B2 are the thick-substrate coefficients. For real transmon islands (a=100-220um, g=6-24um on 500um Si) use fit3 (A=5.49, B=3.42, 4 pct max).
